page_title: UDI 1-2 INT | Udinese v Inter 08/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 1 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Davide Frattesi (Inter) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:2.
90+5' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye punched it onto the post.
90+4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) will miss the next game.
90+3' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+2' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+2' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle. Benjamin Pavard (Inter) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Davide Frattesi (Inter) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
88' A pass from Tajon Buchanan (Inter) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
87' Nicolo Barella (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away.
85' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
85' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
85' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
84' A raking crossfield pass from Benjamin Pavard (Inter) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was in a good position to shoot around the penalty spot after a nice pass, but his effort was unintentionally blocked by one of his teammates.
82' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) comes onto the pitch because Sandi Lovric simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
81' Here is a change. Federico Dimarco is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Thuram leaves the pitch and Marko Arnautovic (Inter) comes on.
81' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
80' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
79' A pass by Matteo Darmian (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
77' Marcus Thuram plays a short pass through to Davide Frattesi (Inter) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
76' A clever short pass gives Florian Thauvin (Udinese) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
74' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
74' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Alexis Sanchez (Inter) replaces Hakan Calhanoglu.
71' Davide Frattesi (Inter) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Martin Payero (Udinese) for Oier Zarraga.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hassane Kamara walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
68' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Darmian (Inter) replacing Denzel Dumfries.
68' It's time for a substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on in place of Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
68' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Piccinini signals.
67' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
66' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

63' Maduka Okoye doesn't have to worry about that one. Federico Dimarco puts a cross in towards Marcus Thuram (Inter), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar.
62' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Lazar Samardzic will be replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
62' Substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue walks off the pitch and Joao Ferreira (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
60' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
59' The ball possession is 20:80.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Maduka Okoye comes off his line to intercept.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Maduka Okoye.
55' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' Referee Marco Piccinini is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Inter!
54' Celebrations by Inter are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
54' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Inter are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
53' The resulting corner, taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), comes to nothing.
53' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' The free kick is taken by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but ball is cleared.
51' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to an offside in the build-up play.
48' Wait! Referee Marco Piccinini has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
48' Goal! The ball from the resulting free kick arrives at the feet of Carlos Augusto (Inter) inside the box, and he fires a lovely shot into the bottom left corner.

47' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Piccinini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Inter, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Marco Piccinini blows the whistle, Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is penalised for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
43' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.

42' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Maduka Okoye shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
40' 1 - 0 Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Yann Sommer. 1:0.
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' 2:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
37' Carlos Augusto (Inter) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
36' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
36' Federico Dimarco (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
34' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
31' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
31' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Maduka Okoye makes a save.
27' The players claim that Marcus Thuram (Inter) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
26' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter). Inter have a corner.
24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

21' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Maduka Okoye pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
19' Maduka Okoye is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Benjamin Pavard (Inter). Easy save!
17' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find Marcus Thuram, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
15' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
15' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
12' Marcus Thuram (Inter) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Piccinini stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
11' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the bottom left corner, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
10' The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Federico Dimarco (Inter) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

7' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

5' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
4' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Walace (Udinese) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Udinese will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Piccinini.
